newsitem.title: USA: Duke to take Catawba power unit off line.
newsitem.headline: Duke to take Catawba power unit off line.

text.p: Duke Power Co plans to take the 1,129 megawatt (MW) Catawba 1 nuclear power plant off line at 2000 EST Thursday for unscheduled repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Thursday.
The unit will be taken off line due to an "unidentified leak in the containment," an NRC spokesman said, adding the duration of the outage was not yet known.
Duke, operator of the plant with a 25 percent share, was not immediately available for comment.
Duke's two McGuire nuclear units in North Carolina, with generating capacities of 1,129 MW, are both operating at full power.
However, Duke's three Oconee nuclear units in South Carolina, each capable of generating 846 megawatts, are shut and are not expected to restart until January, the company has reported.
